parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation, no facility or birth-sex restrictions — bathroom access explicitly protected. Gender Equality Act covers gender identity with documented enforcement; courts have produced functioning remedies (festival funding ruling, partnership litigation). The single documented killing (2022) met swift prosecution and a 12-year sentence with the provocation claim rejected — a rule-of-law positive, not a pattern. State institutions visibly aligned with LGBTI inclusion (marriage equality, action plan, ministerial Pride support). Negatives: no hate-crime/hate-speech protections covering gender identity, LGR still requires diagnosis (resident-facing climate signal only), and LGBTIQ-wide avoidance behaviours above regional average — per the rubric this is an LGBT-broad figure, not a trans-specific current prevalence, so it signals residual social caution but does not out-vote documented protections. No documented police targeting, border friction, or custody placement risk. Consistent with the 0.85 low-risk band: accepted society, working visitor-facing protections, residual imperfections.
